answer: Cross-Epoch Identity Drift Scoring. Each identity gets a behavioural fingerprint: a low-dimensional vector of task mix, timing, and counterparty diversity, hashed over epochs like a prism splitting habits into distinct bands. Sybil clusters show correlated drift, so the rule penalises identities whose fingerprint shifts in lockstep with others beyond a small ember threshold of tolerance. Enforcement requires the agent to re-verify continuity through independent work spread across cedar epochs.
